column3: Bell 'ta-da!': a pickup note, then a bright major chord. The default for done.
8-bit coin pickup: two quick chiptune notes.
Chiptune level-up: a fast rising arpeggio.
Rising chiptune power-up sweep with a wobble.
Three warm marimba notes going up.
Harp glissando sweeping up a pentatonic scale.
A breeze through high wind chimes.
Magic sparkle: a quick shimmer of falling notes.
Snare drum roll that lands on a cymbal crash.
Little songbird chirps and a trill.
Goofy slide whistle going up and back down.
Soft rising two-note chime, like a polite 'hm?'. The default for needs-input.
Knock knock on a wooden door.
Submarine sonar ping with an echo.
Two light taps on a glass.
A toilet flushing. Task: disposed of.
Microwave beeping: your code is ready.
One squeeze of a rubber duck.
Typewriter bell, then the carriage return.
Boxing bell: end of the round.
Wah-wah-wah-waaah sad trombone. For when it 'worked'.
One ring of an old landline phone.
